notes: Indian English, the way a school office speaks to parents: "Class Seven B", "ten o'clock in the morning", "ten thirty in the morning" (never the British "half past ten"), "Saturday, the tenth of October".
Dates say the day of the month as an ordinal word (lexicon.dayOfMonth), so the voice never has to guess how to read a numeral.
Keypad keys are written as numerals ("press 1"); every Indic file writes them as words.
charsPerSecond is the slowest message+menu rate measured by scripts/sampark/verify-voice.ts on 2026-09-30 with the live voice and style prompt (conservative, so the 38 s budget warning fires early).

closureReasons.rain_landslide: heavy rain and the danger of landslides

common.opt_out_confirm: Just to be sure, press 9 once more to stop these calls. You will still hear from us if the school ever has to close in an emergency.
common.opt_out_done: All right, we won't send you these calls any more. You will still hear from us if the school has to close in an emergency. Thank you, and take care.
common.no_input: Thank you for listening. Have a good day.
common.fallback_office: Namaste, this is {schoolName}. We couldn't play our message just now, so please get in touch with the school office. Thank you.

ptm_invite.message: Namaste! This is a recorded message from {schoolName} for {audience}. The parent-teacher meeting is on {date}, at {time}, {venue}. We hope to see you there.
ptm_invite.menu: If you can come, please press 1. If this time does not suit you, press 2. To stop these calls, press 9.
ptm_invite.confirm_1: Thank you! We have told the school that you are coming. See you at the meeting.
ptm_invite.confirm_2: Thank you for letting us know. Please speak to the class teacher or the school office, and they will help you with another time.

event_invite.menu: If you can come, please press 1. If you cannot come, press 2. To stop these calls, press 9.
event_invite.confirm_1: Thank you! We have told the school that you are coming. See you there.
event_invite.confirm_2: Thank you for letting us know. We hope to see you next time.
